# TildaZ v0.9.4

**Heavy output lands about twice as fast.**

- Emoji, ZWJ sequences and CJK text parse roughly twice as fast, and ANSI-heavy output
  about 1.5x — measured on Linux, macOS and Windows.
  ([#550](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/550))
- Fixed a crash that could corrupt memory while printing grapheme clusters when a program
  emits OSC 8 hyperlinks. ([#550](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/550))
- Powerline separators (`U+E0B0`–`U+E0BF`) are drawn by TildaZ itself, so prompts and
  status bars that use them — zellij, starship, powerlevel10k — render on every platform
  even without a Nerd Font installed. They used to show as replacement boxes.
  ([#534](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/534))
- Linux: at fractional display scales, windows and dialogs are no longer resampled — text
  and lines stay sharp at 1.7x — and mouse input lands where you point instead of up to
  two pixels toward the top-left. ([#539](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/539),
  [#552](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/552))
- Windows: dialogs follow the display scale while they are open, and the terminal behind
  them no longer takes typing. Changing the scale used to push the OK button outside the
  window. ([#540](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/540),
  [#567](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/567))

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.9.4-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.9.4-1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.9.4-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.9.4-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.9.4-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 14+ universal | `tildaz-v0.9.4-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.9.4-win-x64.zip` | Unzip and keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.9.4-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary; same layout as the x64 zip. |
